description: All core modules, selectors, and signal models in the Hybrid Pairs Trading Ensemble repo.

stage1_selectors.description: Pair selection algorithms — score stock pairs; ensemble-averaged with user-set weights.

base.notes: Abstract base class all selectors inherit from.

entry_point.notes: Re-exports all selectors from selectors_base.py and the two child modules.

selectors: DistanceSelector — Gatev et al. (2006) normalized SSD

ml.loadWarning: LARGE — 39KB / ~10k tokens. Load only when modifying DL selectors.
selectors: MLSelector — XGBoost with engineered spread features
LSTMSelector — LSTM/BiLSTM multivariate sequence model (max_sequences=50000, batch_size=256)
TransformerSelector — Multi-head self-attention encoder (Lambda bug fixed 2026-04-06)
GNNSelector — Graph Convolutional Network with link prediction
ml.gpuNotes: LSTMSelector and TransformerSelector use TF mixed precision (float16) on CUDA. GNNSelector uses PyTorch Geometric.

stage2_signals.description: Entry/exit signal models — ensemble-averaged, discretized to {+1, 0, -1}.
signals: OUThreshold — Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process (BEST — use ou_only in all experiments)
KalmanHedge — State-space Kalman Filter dynamic hedge ratio
MLSignal — XGBoost/GBM classifier (WORST — overfit OOS, Net SR -0.401; weight=0 in E7)

data.notes: yfinance fetching, CSV/Parquet override. Freq '1D' for all main experiments.

ensemble.notes: Weighted score/signal combination utilities for both stages.

reports.notes: Repository pattern. ReportManager is Singleton via st.session_state. Saves to reports/<YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS>/.

predictions.loadWarning: LARGE — 21KB. Load only for real-time prediction work.

app.loadWarning: VERY LARGE — 60KB / ~15k tokens. Load only for UI/Streamlit changes.
app.notes: All Streamlit UI and orchestration (~1,450 lines). Run with: streamlit run app.py

designPatterns.Singleton: ReportManager cached in st.session_state via get_report_manager()
designPatterns.Strategy: All selectors and entry models are interchangeable via shared interfaces
designPatterns.Repository: ReportManager handles all disk I/O for reports

pluginGuide: To add a new selector: (1) implement class in core/selectors_statistical.py or selectors_ml.py with BasePairSelector interface, (2) add dataclass config, (3) wire into ensemble weight sliders in app.py, (4) add unit test in tests/.
